returns.description: Returning a product bought online within 14 days, refunds, defective products and warranty.
returns.refundIntro: You may return a product bought online within 14 calendar days of receiving it, without giving a reason.
returns.inspection: You may inspect and try the product as you would in a shop. If you used it beyond that and its value dropped as a result, we may deduct that loss of value from the refund.
returns.packagingRequest: Please return the product with its packaging and accessories — it makes the return easier for us to process, but it is not a condition of returning.
returns.exceptionText: A hermetically sealed product that cannot be returned for health or hygiene reasons, if the seal was opened after delivery — for example in-ear earphones. We have no other exception.
returns.stepContact: Tell us you want to return the product — using the form below, by email or by phone: {{contact}}. Give your order number.
returns.stepPickup: Contact us — we will agree whether we send a courier or you send it to us yourself.
returns.stepSend: Send the product back to us within 7 days of telling us.
returns.stepRefund: We will refund the money within 14 days of your notice. We may wait until we have received the product or you show that you have sent it.
returns.refundIncludes: You get back the price of the product and the standard delivery fee you paid.
returns.refundMethod: The refund goes back by the same means of payment: paid by card — to the same card; paid in cash — with your agreement, by bank transfer to the account you give us.
returns.returnShipping: The direct cost of sending the product back is yours.
returns.damagedText: If the product is damaged or differs from your order, you can refuse it at the courier or contact us. We will replace it and we bear the cost of transport.
returns.formIntro: You can also tell us about a return with this text — copy it, fill it in and email it to us:
returns.formStatement: I hereby give notice that I withdraw from my contract of sale of the following product: …
returns.defective: By law a product has a guarantee of 2 years from delivery. A defect that shows within the first 6 months is presumed to have existed from the start.
returns.defectRemedy: If there is a defect, you have the right to demand a free repair or replacement. If that is impossible or cannot be done in a reasonable time — a price reduction or a refund. A minor defect does not end the contract.
returns.manufacturerWarranty: Separately, the product may carry the manufacturer's warranty, usually 12 months. The exact term is in the product description.
returns.warrantyExclusions: The manufacturer's warranty does not cover damage caused by improper use, mechanical impact or liquid.

privacy.description: What personal data we collect, what we use it for, who we share it with and what rights you have.
privacy.collectOrder: first and last name, phone number, delivery city and address, email (optional).
privacy.collectPhoneNote: A phone number is required for an order — we reach you on it for delivery. Giving an email is optional.
privacy.collectAccount: first and last name, email and password, saved addresses, order history. We store the password only in encrypted form — we do not know it and cannot see it.
privacy.collectTech: IP address — for security (limiting sign-in and request attempts). In our logs it is kept only in pseudonymised form. When shop administrators act in the admin panel, the administrator's IP address is recorded with the action.
privacy.useIntro: We process your data for the following purposes, on the following grounds:
privacy.usePurposeOrder: Fulfilling and delivering your order, contacting you about it — to perform the contract
privacy.usePurposeTax: Tax and accounting records — to meet an obligation set by law
privacy.usePurposeAccount: Managing your account — to perform the contract
privacy.usePurposeSecurity: Keeping the site secure and preventing fraud — our legitimate interest
privacy.useText: We do not sell your data and do not use it for advertising.
privacy.shareIntro: Only with those who are necessary to fulfil the order or to run the site:
privacy.shareCourier: Courier service — name, phone, address — for delivery
privacy.shareRender: Render — website hosting; a US company, the server is in the European Union (Frankfurt)
privacy.shareSupabase: Supabase — database, in the European Union
privacy.shareResend: Resend — email, for order confirmation; a US company, so the data also goes to the US
privacy.shareInternal: The internal notification about an order that the shop receives does not contain your personal data — only the order number, the cost of the products, the delivery fee, the total, the number of items, the payment method and a link to the order in the shop's admin panel.
privacy.browserText: The site stores in your browser only what it needs to work: the contents of your cart, your theme choice, your sign-in session and your recent searches. After an order placed without an account — the order number and a random code, so that the order page can be opened from the same browser. We do not use advertising or tracking cookies.
privacy.retentionText: Order data — for the period set by law, for tax records. Account data — until the account is deleted.
privacy.rightsText: In accordance with the Georgian Law “On Personal Data Protection”, you have the right to: access your data, request its correction or deletion, request restriction of its processing, object to its processing and withdraw your consent at any time. To make a request, contact us: {{contact}}.
privacy.rightsComplaint: If you believe your data is being processed in breach of the law, you may apply to the State Audit Office (on 2 March 2026 it took over the functions of the Personal Data Protection Service, which was abolished) or to a court.

faq.description: Answers to frequently asked questions: ordering, delivery, payment, returns and your account.
faq.orderQuestion: How do I place an order?
faq.orderAnswer: Add a product to the cart, go to the cart and click “Checkout”. Fill in the delivery details and confirm.
faq.registrationAnswer: No. You can order without registering. Registration gives you your order history and a saved address — next time the address is filled in automatically.
faq.whereAnswer: To the cities listed in the table{{cities}}.
faq.payAnswer: When you receive the product — in cash or by card.
faq.payAnswerSome: When you receive the product — in cash. Paying by card is possible only in these cities: {{cities}}.
faq.payAnswerCash: In cash, when you receive the product.
faq.timeQuestion: How long will it take to arrive?
faq.returnAnswer: Yes — within 14 calendar days of receiving it, without giving a reason. Details are on the {{link}} page.
faq.statusQuestion: Where can I see my order status?
faq.statusAnswer: If you are registered — in your account, {{link}}.
faq.passwordQuestion: I forgot my password, what should I do?
faq.passwordAnswerOn: On the sign-in page, click {{link}} and enter your account email — we will send you a password reset link.
faq.passwordAnswerOff: Password recovery is currently unavailable. Contact us by phone: {{phone}}.
